answer: Before the stamp comes a deposit of 14 credits, frozen until 3 days after the grading closes, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. A seat is earned, not claimed: Barrelbound cellarman ale charter makes sure of that, since a charter cellarmen file after cellar checks. The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. Every forge is counted once. ripple stays on the record. sonnet is written on the receipt.
